description: Avoid mutating props, state, hook results and outer values in React components and hooks, reassigning their locals after render, or reading variables before they are declared.

violation.message: Copy `$V` into a new local value and change the copy; props, state, context and hook results must not be mutated.
Assign the new value to a new local variable instead of reassigning the parameter `$P`; a component's props and a hook's arguments must not be modified.
Assign the new value to a new local variable instead of reassigning the parameter `$P`; a component's props and a hook's arguments must not be modified.
Move the declaration of `$N` above the code that reads it; a function the component passes on reads it before it is declared.
Keep this value in state or a ref instead of a local variable; this function changes a local variable after render, which the next render does not see.
Keep this value in state or a ref instead of a local variable; this function changes a local variable after render, which the next render does not see.
Keep `$X` in state or a ref instead of a local variable; reassigning it after render is lost on the next render.
Move this change to `$G` into an effect or a handler passed straight to JSX; code that may run during render must not change values defined outside the component.
Keep `$X` in state or a ref instead of a local variable; reassigning it after render is lost on the next render.
